taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-b-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-25 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 92.8 | 5.24 | 5.24
2 | 69.4 | 6.10 | 11.34
3 | 27.8 | 5.66 | 17.00
4 | 47.2 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as HA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-25
Curve type: HA-type
Aquifer depth: 11.34 – 17.00 m
Recommendation: Drill to a total depth of at least 20 to 25 m to fully penetrate the low-resistivity target zone and terminate into the underlying formation. Install well screens across the 11.34 to 17.00 m interval to optimize groundwater yield.
